description.narrative:
Strengthening Resilience in Agriculture, Livelihoods and Markets (STREAM II) main objective is to improve improve prosperity, employment, wellbeing and food security of rural communities in the target states. The programme is financed by Switzerland, Netherlands, Norway and individual contribution from Mercy Corps. All reporting requirements are aligned with the donors to required reports on same dates. The three main outcomes are: Outcome 1: Improved, more efficient, and productive agricultural inputs and output markets Outcome 2: Enable non-farm enterprises and smallholder farmers to add market value and invest in expanded economic opportunities. Outcome 3: Increased psychosocial capacities and social cohesion among communities and market actors.
The programme will target: Direct Beneficiaries: 54,908 farmers, 2657 youth employed, 6,000 community members and 383 beneficiaries Indirect Beneficiaries: 54,000 Farmers, 3,000 youths employed, 6000 community members and 200 MSMEs
